integrity: The proof is analytic from the published Alexander-polynomial formula. Finite numerical evaluations are sanity checks only and are not used to establish uniqueness or the asymptotic expansion.
scientific_limitations: Negative real roots only; the core three-strand family on the a congruent to 1 mod 4 branch; no claim about complex or positive real roots or paired extensions.
title: Two simple negative Alexander roots for the residual exceptional pretzel family
